claims.paraphrase: GLASS combines GAS feature synthesis and LAS RGB synthesis during training. LAS overlays augmented external texture through Perlin and foreground masks. Inference uses the normal branch with the trained detector, without the synthesis branches.

Gaussian feature perturbations undergo normalized detector-loss gradient ascent and truncated radius projection. Hypersphere parameters cover 75% of normal features. These equations constrain learned feature distributions; they do not establish constitutive material or manufacturing process laws.

Two Perlin masks are combined by intersection, union or a single-mask choice with equal probabilities. Texture augmentation selects three of nine operations. MAD-sys uses five texture categories and four weakness levels beta=0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 within the LAS image-mixing family.

Five individuals select weak real anomalies from each MVTec AD category for MAD-man. MAD-sys contains synthetically mixed anomalies. Their reported mean scores must retain their distinct real-versus-synthetic evaluation provenance; selection by five people is not five independently adjudicated survey cohorts.

The main paper reports 3,860 normal and 241 anomalous WFDD images collected in an industrial setting and acknowledges WEIQIAO textile source images. GLASS-j reports WFDD image/pixel AUROC 100/98.9 percent and PRO 94.9 percent. These are author-reported offline results on industry-sourced images, not an independent production-site qualification.

The reported recipe uses a WideResNet-50 backbone, feature levels 2+3, 640 training epochs, batch size 8, an NVIDIA Tesla A800 and an Intel Xeon Gold 6346. Reported metrics are image/pixel AUROC and PRO. Variant improvements are not monotone for every category: Table 1 pill values for GLASS-m are 99.4/99.5 percent and GLASS-j 99.3/99.4 percent.

claims.paraphrase: Background consistency concerns appearance within a product and defect consistency concerns morphology across products. The architecture splits background, defect and fusion DiT components and supervises a mask module with real encoded masks.

Double-free guidance adjusts background and defect directions. Adaptive attention weights emphasize defect regions. Guidance wd varies from 0.2 to 2.8 in Figure 4; illustrated severity is visual defect area/count, without calibrated process or material units.

Zero-shot generation uses normal images of the target product during training and transfers defects learned from other products. It excludes target defect training examples but does not establish zero exposure to the target product or external factory.

Half of the MVTec AD test images are selected for generation training; remaining half is used for segmentation testing. A real-training-set UNet baseline is compared with augmentation by generated samples twice the size of that real training set.

Reported generation metrics are FID and LPIPS across 15 product categories at 512 pixels. DefectDiffu mean FID is 69.35 and LPIPS 0.21; Defect-Gen has LPIPS 0.24. The reported method is not uniformly best on every category or diversity metric.

claims.paraphrase: SeaS fine-tunes shared product-level U-Net and normal/anomaly tokens using separated DA/NA objectives. RMP combines U-Net and VAE features with real-mask focal supervision. claims.paraphrase: One generative model is trained per product across its anomaly types, using 60 normal images and one-third masked anomaly images per type. It produces 1,000 anomaly image-mask pairs per type. The downstream supervised segmentation model is instead shared across all products.
Experiments cover 15 MVTec AD, 12 VisA and 10 MVTec 3D AD categories. MVTec 3D AD is explicitly used for RGB images only, without establishing generated 3D geometry or depth.

IS/IC-LPIPS assess anomalous images, KID assesses normal images, and IC-LPIPS(a) assesses anomaly regions. SeaS reports MVTec/VisA/3D-AD KID values 0.04/0.02/0.06 for normal-image generation, not defect-image KID.

The three downstream uses differ: replace pseudo-anomalies for synthesis-based detectors, add normal images to unsupervised training, and train supervised segmentation from generated pairs plus original normal images. Reported headline gains are +8.66 pixel AP, +1.10 image AP and +12.79 IoU with percent labels; do not pool these unlike tasks.
